remuneration_policy.evidence: Our approach aims to reward sustainable outperformance and hence our 2020 award will vest at the upper end of the possible range. The three-year performance period for Performance Share Plan (PSP) awards granted to our senior leaders in 2020, ended on 31 December 2022. Awards for all participants will vest at 97% of maximum, as shown on page 117 and reflect overachievement in each and every three-year target, as well as delivering a three-year TSR of 58%. We stand by our pay-for-performance philosophy and market-competitive remuneration, and the Committee will continue to engage regularly with shareholders and other stakeholders ahead of the implementation of a new Remuneration Policy in 2024.
